name: Hashrate re-arm under uncrowded funding — structural conviction, no leverage froth
rationale: A momentum trend backed by miner commitment is most durable when it is NOT yet a crowded leverage trade. The thesis pairs two orthogonal confirmations: btc_hashrate crosses UP (slow capital — miners — re-arm, a structural vote of confidence) WHILE perp funding sits BELOW a fitted ceiling (fast capital is not yet crowded long, so there is no over-levered froth waiting to unwind) AND momentum is positive. The combination distinguishes a trend in its durable early phase (slow money in, fast money not yet euphoric) from a late, fragile, over-levered one. Go long spot, direction +1. funding is BOUNDED and read via lt on its raw clamped level; the ceiling [-2e-5,1.0e-4] straddles the realized median up to the +1e-4 cap so the filter genuinely bites (not above realized max). btc_hashrate is drifting, used ONLY via cross_up/cross_down. funding_feature stays null — funding is a crowding FILTER, not a carry to harvest (spot has no funding accrual). Disconfirmer (core falsifier): the edge must come from miner re-commitment adding orthogonal info to the funding-gated trade. If replacing the btc_hashrate cross_up arm with an always-true pass (keeping funding<ceiling + ret_Nd>floor) matches or beats deflated Sharpe, hashrate is redundant and this collapses to the existing funding-gated-momentum spec. Low-confidence until OOS; the Gate decides.
catalyst: btc_hashrate crosses up while funding is uncrowded (below ceiling) and momentum is positive
